entry.title: Playa de la Victoria, Cadiz
entry.summary: Playa de la Victoria is a long beach of fine golden sand stretching along the modern side of Cadiz, with a wide promenade and Atlantic waves. It is a lively city beach, and the old town and cathedral are a short walk or bus ride away.

entry.title: Selce Beach, Crikvenica
entry.summary: Selce is a small resort on the Kvarner coast between Crikvenica and Novi Vinodolski, with pebble beaches, calm water and green pine-covered hills behind. The sea is clear, and the long promenade links the beaches in both directions.

entry.title: Playa de La Herradura
entry.summary: La Herradura is a horseshoe-shaped bay of grey pebbles and coarse sand on the Costa Tropical of Granada, with steep green hills behind and clear blue water. It is a quiet, local resort with a small marina and good diving nearby.

entry.title: Plage de Soulac-sur-Mer
entry.summary: Soulac-sur-Mer is a seaside town at the tip of the Medoc with a wide beach of fine sand and traditional striped beach tents. The Atlantic is cool, and swimming is supervised by lifeguards in summer.

entry.title: Stavros Beach, Crete
entry.summary: Stavros is a small, sheltered bay of fine sand and clear shallow water on the Akrotiri peninsula of Crete. A rocky hill rises behind the beach, and the film Zorba the Greek was shot here.

entry.title: Plage des Sables Blancs, Concarneau
entry.summary: Plage des Sables Blancs is a sheltered beach of pale sand beside the harbour town of Concarneau in southern Brittany. The walled old town, the Ville Close, is a short walk away, and the water is shallow and calm at high tide.

entry.title: Platja de Sant Feliu de Guixols
entry.summary: Sant Feliu de Guixols has a sheltered bay of coarse golden sand in the middle of a lively Costa Brava town, with a long seafront promenade and an old fishing quarter. The water is clear and calm, and rocky headlands protect both ends of the bay.

entry.title: Spiaggia di Lignano Sabbiadoro
entry.summary: Lignano Sabbiadoro has a very wide beach of fine golden sand on the northern Adriatic, with long rows of umbrellas and shallow water. It is a lively family resort with a long promenade and a marina.

entry.title: Spiaggia di Maria Pia, Alghero
entry.summary: Maria Pia is a long beach of pale sand and shallow water just north of Alghero, backed by pine trees and low dunes. It is a family favourite, and the old town walls and harbour are a short drive away.

entry.title: Playa de San Juan
entry.summary: Playa de San Juan is a long beach of fine golden sand on the northern edge of Alicante, backed by palm trees and a wide promenade. The water is warm and shallow, and the tram from Alicante stops nearby.

entry.title: Playa de Trafalgar
entry.summary: Playa de Trafalgar is a long beach of golden sand and rocks near Los Canos de Meca, with the Cape Trafalgar lighthouse on the headland. The setting is wild and open, with strong Atlantic light and little development.

entry.title: Playa de la Fontanilla
entry.summary: La Fontanilla is the main beach of Conil de la Frontera, a wide sweep of fine golden sand with shallow Atlantic water and a promenade. The white old town is a short walk, and the coves of Roche are nearby.

entry.title: Playa de Samil
entry.summary: Samil is a long beach of fine sand in Vigo, with a wide promenade and views towards the Cies Islands. The Atlantic is cool, and the beach is flat and easy, with parks and cafes behind.

entry.title: Plage de Carnac
entry.summary: Carnac-Plage is a sheltered sandy beach in southern Brittany, with colourful beach huts and calm water at high tide. The famous Carnac standing stones are a few kilometres inland.

entry.title: Plage de Biscarrosse
entry.summary: Biscarrosse-Plage is a wide beach of fine sand on the Atlantic coast, backed by tall dunes and pine forest. The waves are strong, surf schools operate in summer, and lifeguards patrol the swimming zones.

entry.title: Praia da Alagoa, Altura
entry.summary: Praia da Alagoa is a long beach of fine golden sand near Altura in the eastern Algarve, with shallow water and a quiet local feel. It is backed by dunes and pine trees, and the Spanish border is a short drive away.

entry.title: Praia da Marina, Vilamoura
entry.summary: Praia da Marina is a wide beach of golden sand next to the large marina at Vilamoura, with a long promenade and calm water. It is a family resort beach with plenty of space and easy walking along the shore.

entry.title: Praia de Supertubos, Peniche
entry.summary: Supertubos is a wide beach of golden sand beside Peniche, known worldwide for its barrelling waves and an annual surf contest. The Atlantic is cool and strong, so swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

entry.title: Praia da Conceicao, Cascais
entry.summary: Praia da Conceicao is a small, sheltered sand beach in the centre of Cascais, with a promenade and an old chapel nearby. The sea is cool and calm, and the train from Lisbon stops in town.

entry.title: Praia do Martinhal, Sagres
entry.summary: Praia do Martinhal is a sheltered bay of fine sand near Sagres on the far west of the Algarve, with rock pools at low tide and calmer water than the Atlantic coast. It is a good base for surf and wild beaches nearby.

entry.title: Kamenjak Beach, Premantura
entry.summary: Kamenjak is a protected peninsula at the southern tip of Istria, with rocky coves, small pebble beaches and low pine scrub. The sea is clear and deep, and the beaches are quiet and wild compared with the busy resorts nearby.

entry.title: Kolymbia Beach, Rhodes
entry.summary: Kolymbia has a long beach of sand and fine pebbles on the east coast of Rhodes, with calm shallow water and umbrellas along the shore. It is quieter than Faliraki and the sea is clear, with beach tavernas along the coast road.

entry.title: Elounda Beach, Crete
entry.summary: Elounda has several small beaches of sand and gravel along a calm, sheltered bay on the northeast coast of Crete. The water is clear, the village has a pretty harbour, and boats leave from nearby for the island of Spinalonga.

entry.title: Georgioupoli Beach, Crete
entry.summary: Georgioupoli has a long, gently shelving beach of sand and fine gravel on the north coast of Crete, with a lively village and a small harbour. The sea is calm and the village squares are lined with eucalyptus trees that give plenty of shade.

entry.title: Perivolos Beach, Santorini
entry.summary: Perivolos is a long beach of dark volcanic sand and fine pebbles on the south coast of Santorini, lined with relaxed beach bars and sunbeds. The sea is deep and clear, and the beach runs on towards Perissa.

entry.title: Cavtat Beach
entry.summary: Cavtat is a small old town south of Dubrovnik, with rock platforms, small pebble beaches and a long coastal path. The sea is clear, and the Mediterranean pines give shade along the shoreline.

entry.title: Plage de La Grande-Motte
entry.summary: La Grande-Motte is a modern seaside town with a very long beach of fine sand, backed by fenced dunes and the pyramid-shaped apartment blocks of its 1960s architecture. The water is shallow and warm, and it is a family resort in summer.

entry.title: Arvanitia Beach, Nafplio
entry.summary: Arvanitia is a small pebble beach at the foot of the Nafplio fortress hill, reached by a path around the rocks. The water is clear and calm, and the town of Nafplio, with its Venetian old town, is a few minutes on foot.

entry.title: Praia de Espinho
entry.summary: Espinho has a wide beach of fine sand on the Atlantic coast south of Porto, with a long promenade and beach bars. The sea is cool and waves are moderate, and surfers use the north end of the beach.

entry.title: Praia da Figueirinha, Setubal
entry.summary: Praia da Figueirinha is a calm sand beach in the Arrabida natural park, with turquoise water and green hills behind. It is one of the most beautiful beaches near Lisbon, and the road in is limited in summer.
